articles.summary: Company to Host Conference Call on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 8:30 am Eastern Time Orthofix Medical Inc . (NASDAQ:OFIX), a leading global medical technology company, today announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Monday, November 9, 2026, before market open. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to review results at 8:30 am Eastern Time the same day. Interested parties may access the conference call by dialing 833-461-5787 in the U.S., and 585-542-9983 in all other locations, and referencing the conference ID 165 515 415. A webcast of the conference call and a copy of the release may be accessed at ir.Orthofix.com. Internet Posting of Information Orthofix regularly shares important updates in the “Investors” section of its website at Orthofix.com .
